data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: Prior year reserves showed a small net adverse development: the Syndicate reports a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (net) in reserves established at the prior year end, principally driven by adverse development in Property, Third Party Liability (Casualty) and Accident & Health. The claims development triangle is distorted by a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction (assumed 2017 reserves from Syndicates 5820 and 1206), and therefore only a net prior-year deterioration figure is available from the accounts. Separately, 2020 experience was materially impacted by the Covid-19 pandemic and an active Atlantic hurricane season (notably Hurricane Laura).
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 473.6m (2019: GBP 302.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 7.9m (2019: deterioration of GBP 8.4m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability and Accident and Health with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
Claims in respect of the Covid-19 pandemic total GBP 128m net of reinsurance recoveries, adding 27% to the net loss ratio.

Catastrophe experience in the year was heavier than expectation and whilst no single loss would be considered market changing on its own, there was a marked increase in the frequency of events contributing 10.7% to the net claims ratio.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities) 2019 comparative column. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was presented; net prior-year deterioration of GBP 7.9m is stated in Note 9 and has been used as a last-resort fallback (NET of reinsurance - no gross figure available). A gross claims development triangle is present but is materially distorted by an RITC (assumption of 2017 reserves from Syndicates 5820 and 1206), making triangle-based PYD unreliable. Top-level monetary fields are converted from the accounts' GBP 000 to millions. Please treat the prior_year_development figure as NET and subject to distortion from the RITC.
